---
title: "AI & Mathematics"
---

Mathematical foundations and artificial intelligence, taught through concrete examples.

## Topics

- [Linear Algebra](linear-algebra.qmd) — Vectors, matrices, projections, eigenvalues, and applications.
- [Calculus](calculus.qmd) — Limits, derivatives, gradients, integration, and optimisation.
- [Probability & Statistics](probability.qmd) — Random variables, distributions, Bayes' rule, and inference.
- [Machine Learning](machine-learning.qmd) — Loss functions, optimisation, generalisation, and model evaluation.

Each topic will grow into a collection of worked examples, conceptual explanations, and interactive experiments.
